A '''battle''' was fought on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during [[Headmaster/Legends|Headmaster]] [[Gentis]]'s [[Ghost Prison incident|coup]]. [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and a group of ex-convicts from [[the Prism]] prison facility retook Coruscant from Gentis.
